entries.title: Interpreting real exponential growth and decay
entries.description: tell from the sign of the exponent whether a signal grows, decays, or stays constant.

entries.title: Defining signal periodicity
entries.description: use $x(t+T)=x(t)$ as the condition for a repeating signal.

entries.title: Defining a generalized exponential signal
entries.description: interpret $x(t)=e^{st}$ with $s=\sigma+j\omega$ as the general exponential form.

entries.title: Interpreting the roles of $\sigma$ and $\omega$
entries.description: identify $\sigma$ as the growth or decay term and $\omega$ as the oscillation term.

entries.title: Expanding a generalized exponential
entries.description: rewrite $e^{(\sigma+j\omega)t}$ as $e^{\sigma t}e^{j\omega t}$ to separate growth from oscillation.
